items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic’s nearly $70 billion IPO plan briefly circulated to banks, then retracted | Reuters
items.summary:
Investors ​had previously discussed a valuation of ​as much as $2 trillion for ⁠Anthropic, but expectations have since come down, with the $1.5 trillion figure viewed as the high end of the range, Reuters previously reported.

Founded in 2021 by former OpenAI executives including Amodei and his sister ​Daniela Amodei, who is now Anthropic's president, Anthropic has emerged as one of the leading generative ​AI developers with ⁠its Claude family of models. [...] The Anthropic IPO comes at a time when other companies in the AI infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed or withdrawn their planned listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave Inc (CRWV.O) and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending. [...] Nov 9 (Reuters) - Details of Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO, including plans by the AI ‌company to raise nearly $70 billion, were briefly circulated to banks before being retracted late on Monday, according to emails seen by Reuters.

items.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans | TechCrunch
items.summary:
Anthropic plans to set a valuation range this week and begin trading on Thursday or Friday of next week, the Journal reported.

Investors will look to Anthropic’s valuation to gauge the strength of the AI boom. Some institutional investors are now pushing for a valuation below the $1.5 trillion target discussed as recently as last week, a figure that was itself considerably below the $2 trillion floated a few months ago, the report said. [...] Posted:

# Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans

Launching a major tech IPO would seem risky right now, shortly after one of Nasdaq’s biggest selloffs and amid revelations that a CEO central to the AI boom had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. But that isn’t deterring Anthropic, which is moving ahead with its listing plans, according to The Wall Street Journal. [...] OpenAI, Anthropic’s main rival, was reportedly valued at $1.25 trillion last week after the ChatGPT maker raised $11 billion in fresh capital, short of the $20 billion it had initially sought.
